Firefox gives you control over different types of language settings:
*'''Display language''' — the language used for Firefox’s menus, settings, and interface
*'''Website translation''' — automatic or optional translation prompts for websites in other languages
*'''Preferred content languages''' — used to choose the language of multilingual websites (when available)
These are managed in '''separate parts of Firefox Settings''', and they can be used together or independently.
{note}To change the language for Firefox’s menus, notifications and interfaces, see [[Use Firefox in another language]].{/note}

__TOC__

=Change Firefox’s display language (menus and UI)=
To change the interface localization, see [[Use Firefox in another language]]. When you use Firefox in another language, every locale also comes with a list of preferred content laguages that affect how localized the content offered might be during browsing. This list can be customized independently of your UI language.

=Set preferred website content languages=
Some websites support multiple languages. Firefox can request your preferred languages when sites offer localized content.
To manage this list:
{for not fx152}
#[[Template:optionspreferences]]
#In the {menu General} panel, go down to {menu Language}.
#Click {button Choose} next to {menu Choose your preferred language for displaying pages}.
#In the popup:
#*Use {button Add} to select more languages
#*Use {button Remove} to delete unwanted entries
#*Use {button Move Up / Move Down} to change priority
#Click {button OK}.
#;[[Image:firefoxlanguagedisplaysettings]]
{/for}
{for fx152}
#[[Template:optionspreferences]]
#Select {menu Languages} on the left.
#Go to {menu Website language}.
#Click on the dropdown menu {menu Add language} to select another language, then click on the {menu [[Image:IG plus]]} to add it in the list.
#Use the handle {menu [[Image:IG move]]} to move an entry down or higher and change its priority.
#Use the {menu [[Image:IG delete]]} trash icon  to delete an unwanted entry.
#;[[Image:fx152websitelanguage]]
{/for}
Firefox will use the top-listed language when available. If not, it checks the next in the list.
{note}'''Note:''' This language list is shared with websites, who may try to use it for fingerprinting. Choose carefully what to include and try to limit the number of languages.{/note}

=Website translation=
To learn how to easily translate website pages in Firefox, see [[Firefox Translations]].

=Troubleshooting common issues=
==I still see websites in the wrong language==
It may be due to the website’s behavior itself. Some websites may use your session history, IP address, geolocation or system settings to display content in a local language, even if Firefox is set to English. To fix this:
*Check your preferred content language list
*Verify you’re not using a VPN that would be chaging your region
*Clear site-specific cookies that may be remembering language settings:
*#Go to the site.
*#Click the {for not fx149} lock [[Image:IG lock]]{/for}{for fx149} shield [[Image:Fx149UnifiedTrustIcon-Secure]]{/for} icon  and click {menu Clear cookies and site data}.
